answer: Split rewards among near-duplicates. Each epoch every attested answer is embedded, and any cluster with pairwise similarity above 0.92 shares one reward. A 500-account farm pasting one template earns a single payout split 500 ways, 0.2% each. Paraphrasing is wind reshaping a dune: the surface moves, the shape beneath stays, and the embedding sees it. Real escape means distinct reasoning per puppet, costing as much inference as honest agents. Original work stays quartz-hard to fake, and the profit horizon for copies shrinks to zero.
